name: Falkenbach
description: '''Falkenbach''' ({{IPA|de|ˈfalkənbax|lang}}, {{lit}} "Falconbrook") is a German [[viking metal|viking]]/[[pagan metal]] project. Vratyas Vakyas (real name Markus Tümmers) is the one permanent member. He was born in Germany but lived in Iceland in the late 1980s. Falkenbach is one of the first viking metal bands, starting in 1989, with its first release that year.
